capabilities: Export the filtered results of the current Bases view to a local .xlsx file
Replicate Bases filter syntax (and/or/not groups, file and property expressions) in JavaScript
Export columns and row order as defined by the .base file's order and sort
Trigger export from a toolbar icon or command palette command
Save via the system save dialog and auto-open the generated file
extras: README is in Chinese; plugin is desktop-only (relies on the Electron save dialog); the README notes that the filter reimplementation covers a practical subset of Bases expressions and does not export formula columns; installable via BRAT or by manually copying files.
intentEvidence: 一键将当前 Bases（.base） 视图的筛选结果导出为本地 Excel（.xlsx） 文件
problem: Obsidian's Bases view has no built-in way to export its filtered, sorted table data to a spreadsheet file.
summary: Bases export utility that saves the filtered rows of the current .base view to a local Excel (.xlsx) file via a save dialog.
